text: Dave ate 14. The seagull ate 14 / 2 = 7. The pigeons ate 3 * 3 = 9. The raccoon ate 2/3 * (14 + 7 + 9) = 2/3 * 30 = 20. The ants ate 1. The total eaten is 14 + 7 + 9 + 20 + 1 = 51. The answer is 51 + 14 = 65.
Tom gets 4 car washes a month. Each car wash costs $15. So in a month he pays 4 * 15 = $60. In a year he pays 60 * 12 = $720. The answer is $720.

The song has 54 lines. The first scene has twice the number of lines, so 54 * 2 = 108. But only a third of them are his lines, so 108 / 3 = 36. The second scene has six more lines than the song, so 54 + 6 = 60. Four-fifths of them are his, so 60 * 4/5 = 48. The total number of lines Sean has to memorize is 36 + 48 = 84. The answer is 84.

Marilyn's first record sold 10 times as many copies as Harald's. So Marilyn's first record sold 10 * Harald's first record. Together they sold 88,000 copies. So 10 * Harald's first record + Harald's first record = 88,000. 11 * Harald's first record = 88,000. Harald's first record = 88,000 / 11 = 8,000. The answer is 8,000.
The sum of their ages is 20. In 10 years, each of them will be 10 years older. So the sum of their ages will be 20 + 10 + 10 = 40. The answer is 40.

Grace weighs 125 pounds. Alex weighs 2 pounds less than 4 times what Grace weighs. So Alex weighs 4 * 125 - 2 = 500 - 2 = 498 pounds. Their combined weights are 125 + 498 = 623 pounds. The answer is 623.
Let's assume the total land is x. He sold 3/5 of it, so he had 2/5 of it left. 2/5 of x = 12.8. x = 12.8 * 5/2 = 32. The answer is 32.
There are 60 letters needing stamps. One-third of 60 is 20. So there were 20 letters already stamped. 20 + 20 = 40. The answer is 40.
Raymond was born 6 years before Samantha. Samantha is now 31. So Raymond was born 31 - 6 = 25. Raymond had a son at the age of 23. So the son was born 25 - 23 = 2. The answer is 2.

John has 10 hectares of a pineapple field. There are 100 pineapples per hectare. So in total, John has 10 * 100 = 1000 pineapples. John can harvest his pineapples every 3 months. So in a year, he can harvest 12 / 3 = 4 times. So he can harvest 1000 * 4 = 4000 pineapples. The answer is 4000.

The top level has a square footage of 16. The second level will have half the square footage of the top level, so 16 / 2 = 8. The third level will have half the square footage of the second level, so 8 / 2 = 4. The fourth level will have half the square footage of the third level, so 4 / 2 = 2. The average square footage of a level is (16 + 8 + 4 + 2) / 4 = 30 / 4 = 7.5. The answer is 7.5.

In the first 20 minutes, he scores 4 points. In the second 20 minutes, he scores 25% more points. 25% of 4 is 1. So he scores 4 + 1 = 5 points in the second 20 minutes. In total, he scores 4 + 5 = 9 points. The answer is 9.
The 2 shirts cost $30 each. So the total cost is 2 * $30 = $60. The discount is 40%. So the discount is 40% of $60 = $24. The answer is $60 - $24 = $36.
There are 3 rows of 8 stars. 2 rows of 6 stars. 76 - (3 x 8) - (2 x 6) = 76 - 24 - 12 = 40. The answer is 40.
Isabelle spent $12 + $43 + $15 + $4 + $22 = $98. She split the cost evenly three ways with her two parents. So each person paid $98 / 3 = $32.67. The answer is $32.67.

In the first month, the program had 60 downloads. In the second month, the number of downloads was three times as many as the downloads in the first month, which is 3 * 60 = 180. However, the downloads were reduced by 30% in the third month. So, the number of downloads in the third month is 180 - (0.3 * 180) = 180 - 54 = 126. The total number of downloads over the three months is 60 + 180 + 126 = 366. The answer is 366.

The opening bid is $200. The bids on the desk rise by $50 each time. 3 other people each bid once. Carmen bids after each of the 3 other people and eventually wins. So Carmen bids 4 times. The bids are $200, $250, $300, $350. The answer is $350.

There were 2 containers of imported vehicles. Each container had 5 vehicles. So there were 2 * 5 = 10 vehicles. After the next day, the total number of vehicles became 30. So the number of vehicles imported on the second day was 30 - 10 = 20. Since each container has 5 vehicles, the number of containers imported on the second day was 20 / 5 = 4. The answer is 4.

Kelly has 5 quarters and 2 dimes. 5 quarters = 5 x 25 = 125 cents. 2 dimes = 2 x 10 = 20 cents. So in total she has 125 + 20 = 145 cents. She buys a can of pop for 55 cents. 145 - 55 = 90. The answer is 90.
The city is 42 miles across. The fog bank takes 10 minutes to cover 3 miles. So it will take 42 / 3 = 14. Then 14 * 10 = 140. The answer is 140.
The initial amount for the first half of the year is $140. The other half of the year is 140 * 0.9 = 126. The total amount is 140 + 126 = 266. The answer is 266.

Each topaz gemstone is one inch long. Each sterling silver bead is one-quarter of an inch long. Each necklace is made to a total length of 25 inches. So there are 25 - 8 = 17 inches of sterling silver beads. 17 / 0.25 = 68. The answer is 68.
John drinks 5 glasses of water on weekdays. 5 x 5 = 25. On weekends, he drinks 1 glass of water. 25 + 1 = 26. The answer is 26.
Candice had 80 post-it notes before she went to work. She placed 220 on cups of coffee. So she had 80 - 220 = -140. She had 23 remaining. So she must have bought 140 + 23 = 163. The answer is 163.

The doll cost as much as 3 action figures and one red car. So the doll cost 3 * $5 + $4 = $15 + $4 = $19. The total cost of all toys is 5 * $5 + 3 * $5 + $19 = $25 + $15 + $19 = $59. The answer is $59.
The inner volume of one box is 5 * 6 * 4 = 120. The inner volume of 3 boxes is 120 * 3 = 360. The answer is 360.

Axel has 50 silver pesos and 80 gold pesos. Anna has twice as many silver pesos as Axel, so she has 2 * 50 = 100 silver pesos. Anna has 40 more gold pesos than Axel, so she has 80 + 40 = 120 gold pesos. Together, they have 50 + 100 + 80 + 120 = 350 pesos. The answer is 350.
Chris has 6 trees. Ferdinand has 6 / 2 = 3 trees. Harry has 2 * 3 + 5 = 11 trees. The answer is 11 - 3 = 8.

Melanie sold a third of her vacuum cleaners at the green house. So she had 2/3 of her vacuum cleaners left. She then sold 2 more to the red house. So she had 2/3 - 2 = 2/3 - 6/3 = -4/3. She then sold half of what was left at the orange house. So she had 1/2 of -4/3 = -2/3. She has 5 left. So she had -2/3 + 5 = 17/3. The answer is 17/3.

Eliza's rate per hour for the first 40 hours she works each week is $10. So for 40 hours, she earns 40 * 10 = $400. She also receives an overtime pay of 1.2 times her regular hourly rate. So her overtime pay is 1.2 * 10 = $12. For 5 hours of overtime, she earns 5 * 12 = $60. Her total earnings for this week are $400 + $60 = $460. The answer is $460.

Theo has $6000. He buys 6 business suits at $100 each. So he spends 6 * $100 = $600. He buys 3 suitcases at $50 each. So he spends 3 * $50 = $150. He buys a flight ticket that costs $700 more than 5 times as much as the cost of a business suit. So the flight ticket costs 5 * $100 + $700 = $500 + $700 = $1200. So he spends $1200 on the flight ticket. He spends $600 + $150 + $1200 = $1950. He wishes to save $2000 for this trip. So he has to spend $2000 - $1950 = $50 on buying gifts for his business partners in South Africa. The answer is $50.
There are 60 dogs. There are 2 cats for every dog. So there are 2 * 60 = 120 cats. The number of rabbits is 120 + 60 - 12 = 168. The answer is 168.

Initially, Elaine had 20 Pokemon cards. After a month, she collected three times that number. So she collected 3 * 20 = 60. In the second month, she collected 20 fewer cards than those she collected in the first month. So she collected 60 - 20 = 40. In the third month, she collected twice the combined number of pokemon cards she collected in the first and second months. So she collected 2 * (60 + 40) = 2 * 100 = 200. In total, she has 20 + 60 + 40 + 200 = 320. The answer is 320.

Annika brought $50 to the town fair. She spent half of it on food and snacks. Half of $50 is $25. She spent an additional $10 for rides. So she spent $25 + $10 = $35. $50 - $35 = $15. The answer is $15.
Each watermelon costs 3 * 15 = 45$. Each orange costs 45 - 5 = 40$. So the total cost is 4 * 45 + 20 * 15 + 10 * 40 = 180 + 300 + 400 = 880$. The answer is 880$.

Dean's mother gave him $28. He bought 6 toy cars and 5 teddy bears. Each toy car cost $2 and each teddy bear cost $1. So he spent 6 * 2 + 5 * 1 = 12 + 5 = 17. His mother then gave him an extra $10. So he had 28 + 10 = 38. After spending $17, he had 38 - 17 = 21. The answer is 21.
There are 6 rows and 6 columns. So there are 6 * 6 = 36 books. She wants to place 20 more than double the number of books. So she needs 2 * 36 + 20 = 72 + 20 = 92. The answer is 92.
Mrs. Sherman made 12 rolls. She fed 6 children with one each. So she had 12 - 6 = 6 rolls left. She broke each of the remaining rolls into 8 pieces. So she had 6 * 8 = 48 pieces. The answer is 48.
The winner got 3/4 of the votes. So the loser got 1/4 of the votes. 1/4 of 80 is 20. The answer is 20.
To find the average, we need to add the scores and divide by the number of tests. 65 + 94 + 81 + 86 + 74 = 400. 400 / 5 = 80. The answer is 80.

In the first 6 hours, Debra saw 30 bees leave the hive. In the next 6 hours, she saw 1/2 that many bees return. 1/2 * 30 = 15. So 15 bees returned. In the next 6 hours, she saw two times as many bees as she saw first leave the hive fly from the hive and leave. 2 * 30 = 60. So 60 bees left. Then every bee that left before that hadn't already returned returns to the hive in the next 6 hours. 60 - 15 = 45. So 45 bees returned. The answer is 45.

44 seniors need to receive awards.  Each senior receives a picture frame that costs $20.  Each picture frame needs to be etched with the logo for an additional 20% cost per frame.  2 of the seniors will also receive pins that are $5.  1/4 of the seniors are officers and they will need to receive cords that are $12 each.  The cost of the picture frames is 44 * $20 = $880. The cost of the etched picture frames is 44 * $20 * 1.2 = $1056. The cost of the pins is 2 * $5 = $10. The cost of the cords is 11 * $12 = $132. The total cost is $880 + $1056 + $10 + $132 = $2078. The answer is $2078.
There were originally 30 cars on the motorway. 5 cars took an exit. So there were 30 - 5 = 25 cars left. 20 cars drove through in the remaining 15 minutes. So 25 - 20 = 5. The answer is 5.

There are 4 snails in one aquarium and 32 snails in another aquarium. The difference between the number of snails in the two aquariums is 32 - 4 = 28. The difference between the number of snails in the two aquariums is twice the amount of fish in both aquariums. So 28 = 2 * fish. fish = 28 / 2 = 14. The answer is 14.
There are 50 socks that need washing. Lindsay washes 10 pairs of socks. 10 pairs of socks is 20 socks. She also washes 15 loose socks. 20 + 15 = 35. 50 - 35 = 15. The answer is 15.

Jill gets paid $20 per hour to teach. She works 35 hours a week. So her salary as a teacher is 35 * 20 = $700. She gets paid $30 per hour to be a coach. She works 15 hours a week. So her salary as a coach is 15 * 30 = $450. Her total salary is 700 + 450 = $1150. The answer is $1150.
Johnny had $20. He added $10. So he had $20 + $10 = $30. After a year, it tripled. So he had $30 * 3 = $90. The answer is $90.
Tommy sells 43 brownies for $3 each. So he makes 43 * 3 = $129. He also sells 23 slices of cheesecake for $4 each. So he makes 23 * 4 = $92. In total, Tommy makes 129 + 92 = $221. The answer is $221.

Adrien's salary four years ago was $40000. His salary was 30% higher than Lylah's. So Lylah's salary was 40000 / 1.3 = 30769.23. After four years, Adrien's salary increased by 40%. So his salary was 40000 * 1.4 = 56000. Lylah's salary increased by 40%. So her salary was 30769.23 * 1.4 = 43076.92. The total salary they were receiving four years later was 56000 + 43076.92 = 99076.92. The answer is 99076.92.

Steve lives 3 miles from the school. 3 miles = 15,600 feet. Steve can bike at 440 feet per minute. So it will take Steve 15,600 / 440 = 35 minutes to get home. Tim lives 2 miles from the school. 2 miles = 10,560 feet. Tim can skateboard at 264 feet per minute. So it will take Tim 10,560 / 264 = 40 minutes to get home. The winner is Steve. Steve will be waiting 40 - 35 = 5 minutes at his house before Tim finishes the race. The answer is 5.

There are 2 houses. Each house has 3 bedrooms. So there are 2 * 3 = 6 bedrooms. Each bedroom has 2 windows. So there are 6 * 2 = 12 windows. There are 2 houses. Each house has 4 windows not connected to bedrooms. So there are 2 * 4 = 8 windows. 12 + 8 = 20. The answer is 20.

Jessa is 20 years old. Joan is 5 years older than Jessa. So Joan is 20 + 5 = 25. Mary is 2 years younger than Joan. So Mary is 25 - 2 = 23. The sum of the ages of the three girls is 20 + 25 + 23 = 68. The answer is 68.

Janet originally had 22 green pens and 10 yellow pens. She bought 6 bags of blue pens and 2 bags of red pens. There were 9 pens in each bag of blue and 6 pens in each bag of red. So she bought 6 * 9 = 54 blue pens and 2 * 6 = 12 red pens. In total, she has 22 + 10 + 54 + 12 = 98 pens. The answer is 98.
The team played 22 games. They won 8 more than they lost. So they won 8 + 12 = 20. The answer is 20.
Jean has 30 lollipops. She eats 2 of them. So she has 30 - 2 = 28 lollipops left. She wants to package 2 lollipops in one bag. So she can fill 28 / 2 = 14 bags. The answer is 14.

The ratio of Betty's popsicles to Sam's popsicles is 5:6. So Betty has 5 parts and Sam has 6 parts. The total number of parts is 5 + 6 = 11. Since the total number of popsicles is 165, each part is 165 / 11 = 15. Betty has 5 * 15 = 75 popsicles. Sam has 6 * 15 = 90 popsicles. The difference is 90 - 75 = 15. The answer is 15.
The first bag has 300 M&Ms. The second bag has 300 + 12 = 312 M&Ms. The third bag has 300 / 2 = 150 M&Ms. So in total, Mary had 300 + 312 + 150 = 762 M&Ms. The answer is 762.

Henry traveled 60 miles in total. He first stopped after 20 miles. His second stop was 15 miles before the end of the trip. So he traveled 60 - 20 - 15 = 25 miles between his first and second stops. The answer is 25.

The first box has 500 pieces. The second box has 3 times more pieces than the first box, so it has 3 * 500 = 1500 pieces. The third box has 1/4 the number of pieces as the first box, so it has 500 / 4 = 125 pieces. In total, Johnny picks up 500 + 1500 + 125 = 2125 pieces. The answer is 2125.
The wire was 4 feet long. 1 foot = 12 inches. So 4 feet = 4 x 12 = 48 inches. The wire was cut into pieces 6 inches long. 48 / 6 = 8. The answer is 8.

Morisette brought 5 apples and 8 oranges. So she brought 5 + 8 = 13 fruits. Kael brought twice the amount of apples and half the number of oranges than Morisette. So he brought 2 * 5 = 10 apples and 8 / 2 = 4 oranges. So he brought 10 + 4 = 14 fruits. In total, they brought 13 + 14 = 27 fruits. The answer is 27.

James has 30 fire type, 20 grass type, and 40 water type. So in total he has 30 + 20 + 40 = 90. After losing 8 of the water type, he has 40 - 8 = 32. After buying 14 grass type, he has 20 + 14 = 34. So in total he has 32 + 34 = 66. The percentage chance that a randomly picked card will be a water type is (32/66) * 100 = 48.48%. Rounded to the nearest integer, it is 48%.

On Tuesday, she had 1 hour of practice. On Thursday, she had 2 hours of practice. On Saturday, she had 2 * 1 = 2 hours of practice. So in total, she had 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 hours of practice. The answer is 5.

The ratio of teaspoons of sugar to cups of water is 7:13. So the total number of parts is 7 + 13 = 20. The total number of teaspoons of sugar and cups of water is 120. So the number of teaspoons of sugar is 7/20 * 120 = 42. The answer is 42.
Bailey receives $5 weekly for 8 weeks. So she receives $5 * 8 = $40. She has $100 at the end of the 8 weeks. So she started with $100 - $40 = $60. The answer is $60.

Each person consumes 0.2 kg of rice every meal. So in total, 5 people consume 5 * 0.2 = 1 kg of rice every meal. Since they eat lunch and dinner, they consume 1 * 2 = 2 kg of rice every day. A 42 kg bag of rice will last 42 / 2 = 21 days. Since there are 7 days in a week, the bag of rice will last 21 / 7 = 3 weeks. The answer is 3.

Luke ate 2 hot dogs. Thomas ate 3 times more than Luke. So Thomas ate 3 * 2 = 6 hot dogs. John ate half the amount Thomas ate. So John ate 6 / 2 = 3 hot dogs. John ate 3 - 2 = 1 more hot dog than Luke. The answer is 1.
There are 16 balls. Half of the balls are golf balls. So there are 16 / 2 = 8 golf balls. Half of the golf balls are blue. So there are 8 / 2 = 4 blue golf balls. The answer is 4.

On Monday, Robert collects 20 shells. Kylie collects 5 more than Robert. So Kylie collects 20 + 5 = 25. On Tuesday, Kylie collects 2 times more than she did on Monday. So Kylie collects 2 * 25 = 50. The answer is 50.

Griffin had 24 fries. Kyle took 5. Billy took 2 * 5 = 10. So 24 - 5 - 10 = 9. Then Ginger gave Griffin a handful of her fries. Let's say she gave him x fries. So 9 + x = 27. x = 27 - 9 = 18. The answer is 18.

The Doubtfire sisters have 7 adopted kittens. Patchy has had thrice the number of adopted kittens. So Patchy has had 3 * 7 = 21. Trixie has had 12. So in total, the Doubtfire family has 7 + 21 + 12 = 40. The answer is 40.

Mary has 30 sheep. She gets 1 kg of milk from half of them. Half of 30 is 15. So she gets 15 * 1 = 15 kg of milk from the first half. She gets 2 kg of milk from the other half. Half of 30 is 15. So she gets 15 * 2 = 30 kg of milk from the second half. In total, she gets 15 + 30 = 45 kg of milk every day. The answer is 45.

Lloyd earns $10 an hour. He tutored 5 hours for the first week. So he earned 5 * 10 = $50. He tutored 8 hours for the second week. So he earned 8 * 10 = $80. In total, he earned $50 + $80 = $130. The answer is $130.

The first train travels 80 miles in the first day and 150 miles in the second day. So the total distance covered by the first train is 80 + 150 = 230 miles. The second train travels 150 miles in the first day and 80 miles in the second day. So the total distance covered by the second train is 150 + 80 = 230 miles. The answer is 230 miles.

Mike was a pen pal with 5 people.  He stopped being penpals with 2 of them.  So he is still a pen pal with 5 - 2 = 3 people.  They each send 2 letters a week that are 5 pages long.  So in total they send 3 * 2 * 5 = 30 pages a week.  He can write a page every 6 minutes.  So he can write 30 pages in 30 * 6 = 180 minutes.  He spends 180 / 60 = 3 hours a week writing. The answer is 3.

Each can of tomatoes contains 3 tomatoes. Freda’s last batch of sauce made 32 ounces of sauce. Since the sauce is half the volume of the can, the can must have been 32 * 2 = 64 ounces. Each can contains 3 tomatoes. So 64 / 3 = 21.33. Since Freda can’t use a fraction of a tomato, she must have used 21 tomatoes. The answer is 21.

The bridge can carry 5000 pounds. The driver and the empty truck weigh 3755 pounds. So the maximum weight of the boxes is 5000 - 3755 = 1245 pounds. Each box weighs 15 pounds. So the maximum number of boxes is 1245 / 15 = 83. The answer is 83.

The gas station is selling gas for $3.00 a gallon. The app company is offering $.20 cashback per gallon. So for 10 gallons, the gas station is charging $3.00 x 10 = $30.00. The app company is giving $.20 x 10 = $2.00. So the total cost is $30.00 - $2.00 = $28.00. The answer is $28.00.
Marcell's roll-ups are 3 wide and 14 long. So he ate 3 * 14 = 42. Beatrice's roll-ups are 2 wide and 24 long. So she ate 2 * 24 = 48. The average is (42 + 48) / 2 = 45. The answer is 45.

The house was originally worth $80,000. Josh spent $50,000 on repairs. So the house was worth $80,000 + $50,000 = $130,000. The house increased in value by 150%. 150% of $130,000 is $195,000. So the house was worth $195,000 after the repairs. Josh spent $80,000 + $50,000 = $130,000. So he made $195,000 - $130,000 = $65,000. The answer is $65,000.
Nancy owes $0.50 cents for each of 8 books. So she owes 8 * $0.50 = $4.00. She also owes a flat $2.00 fee. So in total she owes $4.00 + $2.00 = $6.00. The answer is $6.00.

Six years ago, Cera was 46 - 6 = 40. Noah was half as old as Cera, so Noah was 40 / 2 = 20. The population of Chile six years ago was 3000 times the age of Noah, so the population of Chile six years ago was 3000 * 20 = 60000. The population of Chile now is 60000 + 3000 = 63000. The answer is 63000.

The first friend pressed on the doorbell 20 times. The second friend pressed on the doorbell 20 + 20/4 = 25 times. The fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times. The third friend pressed on the doorbell 60 + 10 = 70 times. The total number of doorbell rings is 20 + 25 + 60 + 70 = 175. The answer is 175.

There are 105 members in total. Let's say there are x players on the defense. Then there are 2x players on the offense. And there are x/2 players on the special teams. So in total, there are x + 2x + x/2 = 105. Simplifying, we get 3x + x/2 = 105. Multiplying both sides by 2, we get 6x + x = 210. Combining like terms, we get 7x = 210. Dividing both sides by 7, we get x = 30. The answer is 30.

Sally Four is the same age as Sally Thirtytwo. Sally Thirtytwo is 8 years old. So Sally Four is also 8 years old. Sally Two is three years older than Granny Red. Granny Red is two times as old as Sally Four. Sally Four is 8 years old. Granny Red is 2 * 8 = 16 years old. Sally Two is 3 years older than Granny Red. Granny Red is 16 years old. Sally Two is 16 + 3 = 19 years old. The total age of the four birds is 8 + 16 + 19 + 8 = 51. The answer is 51.

Jamal's phone can hold 1800 photographs. Brittany's phone can hold 1800 / 6 = 300 photographs. Brittany's phone can hold 50 times more photographs than the number of birds in Jamal's photograph of the ducks at the zoo. 300 = 50 * x. x = 300 / 50 = 6. The answer is 6.

The whiteboard is shared between 4 teachers. Each teacher has 2 lessons per day. So in total, there are 4 x 2 = 8 lessons per day. The whiteboard is cleaned 3 times per lesson. So in total, the whiteboard is cleaned 8 x 3 = 24 times per day. The answer is 24.

The coffee is cooled by 65 degrees. Each ice cube cools the coffee by 13 degrees. So 65 / 13 = 5. The coffee is 5 times weaker. The coffee is also 12 milliliters weaker. So the coffee is 5 * 12 = 60 milliliters weaker. The coffee is also 15 milliliters weaker. So the coffee is 60 + 15 = 75 milliliters weaker. The answer is 75.

Carlos rents a canoe for $30 an hour. He uses it for 3 hours. So he pays 30 * 3 = $90. Benji rents a banana boat raft for $18 an hour. He uses it for 5 hours. So he pays 18 * 5 = $90. The total cost is 90 + 90 = $180. The answer is $180.

Annabelle already has $80. She earns $10 per hour at her first job for 20 hours. So she earns $10 * 20 = $200. She earns $5 per hour at her second job for 15 hours. So she earns $5 * 15 = $75. In total, she earns $200 + $75 = $275. She needs $400 - $275 = $125. The answer is $125.

Baldur gets 5 pails of water every morning. He gets 6 pails of water every afternoon. So he gets 5 + 6 = 11 pails of water every day. Each pail contains 5 liters of water. So he gets 11 * 5 = 55 liters of water every day. The answer is 55.
John collects peaches for 3 hours.  He can collect 2 peaches a minute.  So in 3 hours, he collects 2 * 60 * 3 = 360 peaches. The answer is 360.

Vincent can buy flowers in packages of 3 for $2.50 or in packages of 2 for $1. To buy 18 flowers, he can buy 6 packages of 3 for $2.50. This would cost 6 * $2.50 = $15. Alternatively, he can buy 9 packages of 2 for $1. This would cost 9 * $1 = $9. Vincent saves $15 - $9 = $6. The answer is $6.

Mitchel went down the slide 30 times. Anne went down 30% less than Mitchel. 30% of 30 is 9. So Anne went down 30 - 9 = 21 times. Robert went down 4 times as much as Anne. 4 * 21 = 84. The answer is 84.
Mark has $50 in his bank account. He earns $10 per day. So he needs $300 - $50 = $250. He needs to save $250. He earns $10 per day. So he needs to save for 250 / 10 = 25 days. The answer is 25.

Job A pays $15 an hour for 2000 hours a year. So the gross pay is $15 * 2000 = $30,000. The tax rate is 20%. So the tax is $30,000 * 0.2 = $6,000. The net pay is $30,000 - $6,000 = $24,000. Job B pays $42,000 a year. The property tax is $6,000. So the net pay is $42,000 - $6,000 = $36,000. The tax rate is 10%. So the tax is $36,000 * 0.1 = $3,600. The net pay is $36,000 - $3,600 = $32,400. The difference in net pay is $32,400 - $24,000 = $8,400. The answer is $8,400.
The probability of rolling a number greater than 3 is 3/6 = 1/2. The probability of rolling two even numbers in a row is 1/2 * 1/2 = 1/4. The difference is 1/2 - 1/4 = 1/4. The answer is 25%.

The pink frog weighs 50 pounds. The blue beetle weighs 50 pounds. The green toad weighs 50 pounds. The yellow snake weighs 50 + 10 = 60 pounds. The red bird weighs 50 - 20 = 30 pounds. The total weight of the animals is 50 + 50 + 50 + 60 + 30 = 240 pounds. The container weighs 20 pounds. The total weight of the animals and the container is 240 + 20 = 260 pounds. The answer is 260.

Zaid earns 6000$ per month. He spends 1/4 of his salary on rent. 1/4 of 6000 = 1500. He spends 1/3 of his salary on car fuel. 1/3 of 6000 = 2000. He donates half of the remaining amount to his favorite charity. 6000 - 1500 - 2000 = 2500. Half of 2500 = 1250. He gives his daughter 200$ to use for her weekly expenses. 2500 - 200 = 2300. He gives his wife 700$ to budget for groceries and other household goods. 2300 - 700 = 1600. The answer is 1600.

John has 13 lego sets. He sells them for $15 each. So he gets 13 * 15 = $195. He buys 8 video games for $20 each. So he spends 8 * 20 = $160. He has $5 left. So he has $195 - $160 - $5 = $30. He spent $160. So he has $195 - $160 = $35. He has $35 left. He has 13 - 3 = 10 lego sets left. The answer is 10.
